description: On the table in front of you there’s an open black carrying case with foam cutouts, two small clear jars with white lids, a yellow brush-like item, a gray oval piece, and a small white duck-shaped object. The left hand stays resting near the left side of the table while the right hand picks up one jar and sets it into the foam, places the second jar beside it, then adds the yellow brush and slides the gray oval piece into the case; finally, the right hand picks up the duck-shaped item and nests it into an empty cutout before lifting away, leaving the case open with everything arranged inside.
